AOI generating event list to HMI screen from selected output list tag. Release ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Instruction to rework multiple event output list into the HMI array. Only one backing tag for multiple lists is supported through the node selection, variable output list size allowes different faceplate size for different display resolutions, page up page down supported switching between lists by next prev button supported (searching mechanism to find next available event list to display)
